evidence.name: Screen field: Space around the media
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Space around the media" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Space around the media
sections.description: Adds empty space on the four sides of the media (top, right, bottom, left) so it isn't flush against the screen edges or neighboring content. Leave it at the default for a full-width visual. Increase a side to inset the media and give it a framed look with breathing room, rather than edge-to-edge.
